channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Dow jumps 600 points, heads for best day in a month as yields fall: Live updates
item.description: Investors grew hopeful that the Federal Reserve may leave interest rates unchanged this month.

item.title: Hugging Face approached Nvidia’s Huang weeks ahead of $12.9B acquisition, CEO tells CNBC
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said that with Hugging Face, the chipmaker will "expand access to AI for developers and institutions worldwide."

item.title: The world appears to be entering a higher-rate era. Here’s who will pay the price
item.description: The bond sell-off is owed to a mix of high government debt issuance, an oil-price shock that has reignited inflation concerns, and expectations of higher rates.

item.title: Elon Musk starts spending his midterm election millions, revealing his key Senate targets
item.description: Elon Musk’s America PAC is spending in key Senate races including Texas and Maine, days after Musk met with House Speaker Mike Johnson.

item.title: Leon Black sues House Oversight over Epstein probe subpoenas, won't appear Thursday
item.description: Black's attorneys say the NDAs being sought by the panel have nothing to do with his dealings with notorious sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: One stock on Josh Brown's list is a 'double AI beneficiary' that just climbed to all-time highs
item.description: This name made Josh Brown's Best Stocks list in May 2025.

item.title: How Meta will pull off massive changes to its social media apps
item.description: Meta settled its child safety case. Now comes the hard part of actually implementing changes to its social media platforms. Here's what to expect.

item.title: Anthropic's distillation battle turns to the dark web as China concerns swell
item.description: Foreign adversaries have been illegally accessing American AI systems to train competing technology, and selling copycat versions at a lower price.

item.title: 'No steering wheel, no pedals': Tesla teases fans ahead of long-awaited Cybercab update
item.description: Tesla first unveiled the Cybercab almost two years ago, and fans of the company have been waiting to hear more.

item.title: Brent oil price above $96 per barrel after Iran fires missiles at Kuwait
item.description: Oil prices have gained more than 7% this week The U.S. and Iran have traded military strikes this week for the first time since July.

item.title: NBA suspends Clippers owner Ballmer for one year in Kawhi Leonard salary cap probe
item.description: The NBA also fined the Los Angeles Clippers $30 million and said the team will forfeit five first-round picks, one in each year in drafts starting in 2029.

item.title: NFL set for first-ever game in Melbourne, Australia, in international expansion
item.description: The San Francisco 49ers and the L.A. Rams are playing the NFL's first-ever game in Australia, marking an expanded push to grow the game internationally.

item.title: Gloria Steinem, a potent voice of U.S. feminism and co-founder of Ms. Magazine, has died
item.description: Gloria Steinem, the co-founder of Ms. Magazine and a fierce advocate for feminist causes throughout her life, has died. She was 92.

item.title: Iran strikes Kuwait as Trump says renewed Mideast hostilities will not last 'too long'
item.description: On Thursday, Kuwait's army said it was confronting hostile missile and drone attacks from Iran.

item.title: Yields are lower even as oil prices rise. Here's what's going on
item.description: Over the past few weeks, one thing has been certain: Oil prices rise, driving yields higher and pushing stocks lower. Except that's not happening Thursday.

item.title: Campbell's forecasts weak year ahead on pressured consumer spending
item.description: "Our results remain unacceptable," CEO Mick Beekhuizen said, adding that Campbell's will be "addressing reality head-on."

item.title: Average 401(k), IRA balances hit record highs — but more workers are raiding their accounts, Fidelity says
item.description: Retirement account balances rose in the second quarter amid market gains, according to Fidelity. At the same time, more savers tapped their accounts for cash.

item.title: Trump and Xi are set to meet in DC. Why some China watchers have low expectations
item.description: Trump's summit with Xi is expected to take place less than six weeks before the U.S. election, with polls showing Democrats favored to make gains in Congress.

item.title: Dutch central bank moves gold bars out of U.S. and Canada, citing ‘crisis preparedness’
item.description: DNB said gold stored with the Bank of England is more readily tradable, allowing it to be deployed more quickly in a severe crisis.

item.title: Tyson Foods cuts annual profit forecast again as beef pressure drains margins
item.description: Tyson Foods cut its profit forecast and lowered its annual sales ​target, blaming increased ​pressure in ​its beef segment due to expected weak cattle prices.

item.title: Big lessons from 12 stock exits, including Cramer's biggest-ever disappointment
item.description: For stock investors, 2026 has meant constantly adjusting to geopolitical and economic pressures — and most importantly, protecting profits.

item.title: How to save on Thanksgiving travel with your credit card
item.description: Holiday travel is more expensive this year, but with the right card (and smart planning), you can keep costs down.

item.title: 'Danger zone of extreme weather': UN warns of supersized El Niño set to hit global economy and markets
item.description: Latest modeling shows high risks of floods, drought and extreme heat persisting until February 2027.

item.title: Putin floats 'chance' at peace with Ukraine as NATO chief warns Russia is becoming 'increasingly reckless'
item.description: Putin said peace with Ukraine remains possible while calling Kyiv’s warning on Russian airspace “state terrorism,” as NATO flags fresh risks.

item.title: Billionaire family offices back healthcare and biotech startups in August
item.description: The personal investment firms of titans like Stanley Druckenmiller are backing innovations in gene editing, drug discovery and more.

item.title: How much money Americans in their 30s and 40s have in their 401(k)s—see how you stack up
item.description: Here's how financial pros say you can tell if you're on track to retire, and how to catch up if you've fallen behind.

item.title: Hidden China risks are emerging in America’s multibillion-dollar AI data center boom
item.description: U.S. AI data centers rely on China-linked supplies of transformers, batteries and optical gear as Washington moves to tighten restrictions on foreign equipment.

item.title: EnQuest is interested in buying BP’s North Sea assets, CEO tells CNBC
item.description: EnQuest CEO Amjad Bseisu told CNBC the company is interested in BP’s U.K. North Sea assets as the oil major explores a sale of the business.

item.title: Ford's production of highly profitable Super Duty trucks hits 20-year high as it recovers from supplier fires
item.description: Ford reported its eighth consecutive month of year-over-year U.S. new vehicle sales declines in August.

item.title: China hits back at G20 statement on its reliance on exports, accusing them of 'promoting protectionism'
item.description: China rejected G20 pressure over export-driven growth while also challenging U.S. Iran sanctions and European trade measures.
